entities.summary: The Kuahuqiao site is an early Neolithic site of Kuahuqiao culture near Xianghu village, Xiaoshan District, in suburban Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. It was first discovered in the early 1970s during the construction of a local brick factory, which destroyed a large part of the site, though professional excavations first started in 1990.
